# Keep the Light 1.33.0

- **Uses the whole window.** In a wide window the Convert tab shows its settings in two columns, so most of them fit without scrolling, and the other tabs use the full width. Narrow windows look as before.
- **Text size** in ⚙ Settings (90%–150%) makes everything bigger or smaller, so the window looks right on 1080p and 4K screens. Ctrl + and Ctrl − work too.
- **The window remembers its size and place.**
